about: Task and Milestone extraction cases for scripts/eval.mts (`--suite items`, issue #116). Each case is self-contained: the sources go straight to the production `modelExtractItems` prompt (or `heuristicExtractItems`), and the output is filtered by the production `traceItems` against the refs below. `expect.items` lists every item a correct extraction keeps, and nothing else: `title` groups are matched as whole words on the normalised title (any spelling in a group, every group), and `owner`, `dueDate`, `startDate` (null when omitted) and `milestone` (when set) must equal what trace stored, with a named owner or Milestone resolved to a known id. `forbid` terms must not appear in any kept title or description. Graded by `gradeItems` in evals/grade.ts.

sources.title: Pilot readiness call
sources.text:
Priya Nair: Morning all. Let's go round the table on pilot readiness.
Tom Alvarez: Replication lag held under two seconds all week.
Wei Ling: Parity is at 99.2 percent. The misses are all in refund rows.
Marcus Reyes: The vendor still hasn't confirmed the file cut-off time.
Priya Nair: That has been open for a while. It is on the risk log.
Nadia Rahman: Support asked whether merchants will get any notice before the pilot.
Priya Nair: They should, it would be good to tell them something.
Tom Alvarez: We could maybe add a banner in the dashboard at some point.
Nadia Rahman: I'll draft the merchant comms email for the pilot by 2026-10-07.
Priya Nair: Thanks Nadia.
Wei Ling: Refund rows are next on my list either way.
Priya Nair: Good. Same time next week.

sources.title: Architecture review
sources.text:
Priya Nair: Decided: we cut over the pilot using Postgres logical replication instead of application dual-write, because dual-write touches nineteen write paths.
Tom Alvarez: Agreed. Replication is two days of setup and no application change.
